question: 'Dhenka' is a popular ________ musical instrument from the state of Odisha.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chordophone.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Dhenka**' is a popular **Chordophone musical instrument **from the state of Odisha.
 
• The instrument Dhenka is alone responsible for the composition of a number of poems by Kavisurya Baladeva Ratha through its novel melodious tunings.
 
• Music is the heart and soul of Odishan's life. 
 
• The stringed musical instruments like Veena, Kendra, Sarangi, Ektara, Behela, Dhenka are well-known and in vogue throughout the State. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Instruments were categorised into four groups in Bharat Muni's Natya Shastra (written between 200 BC and 200 AD):

 
 
• Avanaddha Vadya (membranophones or percussion instruments),
 
• Ghan Vadya (idiophones or solid instruments), 
 
• Sushir Vadya (aerophones or wind instruments), and 
 
• Tat Vadya (solid instruments) (chordophones or stringed instruments).
